extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: MINT-1T is a multimodal interleaved dataset containing one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.publisher: University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of California, Berkeley
extraction.citeAs: Awadalla et al., MINT-1T: Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MINT-1T curates a large-scale open-source dataset that taps into more diverse sources of interleaved documents such as PDFs and ArXiv papers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Web API, Document analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset construction process involved filtering out documents that contain no images or more than thirty images or any images with URLs that include inappropriate substrings.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: MINT-1T comprises HTML, PDF, and ArXiv documents.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Data was collected from January 2024 to June 2024, including web data from 2013 to 2024.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: No data imputation protocol is mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data manipulation involved filtering low-quality documents, deduplicating data, and removing not safe for work and undesirable content.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was preprocessed to remove low-quality text, duplicate documents/text portions, and remove not safe for work and low-quality images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: No human annotation protocol is mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: No human annotation platform is mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: No data annotation analysis is mentioned.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: NSFW image detection: https://github.com/GantMan/nsfw_model, Language identification: https://fasttext.cc/, Text quality filters: https://github.com/huggingface/datatrove, Deduplication: https://github.com/allenai/bff, PDF parsing: https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be updated by the authors of this work. Updates will be communicated through the README in the Huggingface interface.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset may contain personally identifiable information such as email addresses and IP addresses, which have been masked.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset can be used to train large multimodal models, potentially impacting various applications.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset construction process may introduce biases, and dataset consumers are encouraged to further filter the data based on their use case.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may contain offensive content, and users are responsible for ensuring its legal use in commercial settings.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training large multimodal models, generating interleaved images and text sequences, or building multimodal document retrieval systems.
